changelog:
- Initial release of the "minimalist" skill for subtraction-first engineering.
- Enforces a code-minimalist workflow: always prefer deleting, reusing, or using the smallest correct change.
- Supports "lite", "full" (default), and "ultra" intensity levels for strictness.
- Explicitly avoids over-engineering, unneeded abstractions, and extra dependencies.
- Includes safety guardrails: never compromise on validation, security, or error handling.
- Active on every coding-related response until switched off; does not auto-apply to non-coding requests.
summary: Subtraction-first engineering for any coding task. Channels an engineer who ships by deleting: question whether the change needs to exist (YAGNI), reuse what...
